hypotheses.W0_suffix_gradient_improves_direction: A discovery-only suffix-gradient-weighted rank-64 support improves directional accuracy over activation-only support by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.W1_suffix_gradient_improves_effect: Its mean signed class-score shift is at least twice the activation-only support's shift.
hypotheses.W2_direct_weight_path_helps: A purely weight-based direct-write selector improves directional accuracy over activation-only support by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.W3_suffix_gradient_tracks_full_path: Suffix-gradient support has at least 0.50 correlation with full layer-1 product-patch effects.
hypotheses.W4_output_aware_effect_generalizes: On uniformly sampled pairs, suffix-gradient support is directionally correct on at least 60% and exceeds activation-only support.
hypotheses.W5_selection_is_discovery_only: Fixed output-aware supports use only weights and disjoint discovery activations/gradients; held-out endpoint magnitude remains an upper control.
